stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A riverbank had been covered with concrete for many years.”?
options: They also made sure families without money could receive free water support.
It was also about understanding effort, difficulty, and the people who made the week easier.
The school also made a physical memory corner in the library.
It prevented some flooding, but it also made the river fast and lifeless.
